title: MRgRT OAR Thorax (clean, n=303)
description: Thoracic organs-at-risk (OAR) segmentation dataset derived from TotalSegmentator MRI v2.0.0 (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14710732). Quality filter applied: cranio-caudal FOV >= 120 mm, lung volume >= 300 mL, heart volume >= 50 mL, esophagus volume >= 5 mL, lungs not touching image boundaries. 303 patients out of 616 retained (49.2%). NIfTI format, 4 OAR classes. Source license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Filtering script: scripts/transfer/05_filter_quality.py in https://github.com/NSSIRI/mrgrt-seg
